lines.zh: 我慢悠悠走到河边，喝一口
lines.en: I stroll to the river and take a sip.

lines.zh: 水豚走路，从来不着急
lines.en: Capybaras never hurry when they walk.

lines.zh: 我脚趾间有蹼，踩泥不陷
lines.en: Webbing between my toes keeps me off the mud.

lines.zh: 草丛里那条小路是我踩的
lines.en: That little trail in the grass is mine.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都被压平了
lines.en: Everywhere I walk, the grass lies flattened.

lines.zh: 前头有水声，我加快一点
lines.en: Water sounds ahead, so I speed up a little.

lines.zh: 我这身板，是最大的啮齿类
lines.en: This body of mine is the largest rodent kind.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着背，走起来舒服
lines.en: The sun warms my back and makes walking pleasant.

lines.zh: 一群都跟着我，慢慢挪过去
lines.en: The whole herd follows me, shuffling along.

lines.zh: 我边走边啃两口嫩草
lines.en: I nibble tender grass as I walk along.

lines.zh: 泥岸滑，我一步踩实了再走
lines.en: The bank is slick, so I plant each step.

lines.zh: 到水边了，先站一会再下去
lines.en: At the water's edge, I pause before entering.

lines.zh: 我留了一路湿脚印
lines.en: I left a trail of wet footprints.

lines.zh: 走累了就坐下，不用理由
lines.en: Tired of walking, I sit, no reason needed.

lines.zh: 我踩着泥，一步一个浅坑。
lines.en: I tread the mud, one shallow print per step.

lines.zh: 水边的草绊脚，我慢慢抬腿。
lines.en: The bank grass trips me, so I lift my legs slowly.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岸边，像块大土豆
lines.en: I squat on the bank like a big potato.

lines.zh: 嘴里嚼着草，眼睛半闭
lines.en: Chewing grass with my eyes half closed.

lines.zh: 水面很平，能看见我的脸
lines.en: The water is calm and shows my face.

lines.zh: 别的动物都爱挨着我坐
lines.en: Other animals like to sit close to me.

lines.zh: 我不吵，也不抢，坐着就好
lines.en: I do not shout or grab, I just sit.

lines.zh: 今天不游泳了，晒晒太阳
lines.en: No swimming today; I am sunbathing instead.

lines.zh: 牙齿一直在长，得磨一磨
lines.en: My teeth keep growing, so I must grind them.

lines.zh: 河对岸那只鸟叫了一早上
lines.en: That bird across the river called all morning.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，露出两颗大门牙
lines.en: I yawn and show my two big front teeth.

lines.zh: 草尖上有露水，正好解渴
lines.en: Dew on the grass tips quenches my thirst.

lines.zh: 谁在水里扑腾，吵到我了
lines.en: Someone is splashing and it disturbs my peace.

lines.zh: 我这毛皮厚，晒久了发烫
lines.en: My fur is thick and grows hot in the sun.

lines.zh: 一整天什么也不做，挺好
lines.en: Doing nothing at all day is quite fine.

lines.zh: 水边的风带着藻类的味道
lines.en: The riverside wind smells of algae.

lines.zh: 一只小鸟停在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: A small bird lands on my back. I stay still.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在泥岸上，发呆。
lines.en: I rest my chin on the muddy bank and stare.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就跟你平视了
lines.en: You crouch down, and we are at eye level.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，我有点兴趣
lines.en: That grass in your hand interests me somewhat.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，但也别摸我头
lines.en: I do not fear people, but do not pat my head.

lines.zh: 你坐这儿吧，岸边还有位置
lines.en: Sit here, there is room on the bank.

lines.zh: 你身上有晒干的草味
lines.en: You smell of sun-dried grass.

lines.zh: 我歪头是想听清你说什么
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear you properly.

lines.zh: 你站那么久，腿不累吗
lines.en: Standing that long, do your legs not tire?

lines.zh: 别拿棍子，我看了会紧张
lines.en: Put the stick down, it makes me nervous.

lines.zh: 我们这样安静待着，就很好
lines.en: Us sitting quietly like this is quite nice.

lines.zh: 你笑了，我也把眼睛眯起来
lines.en: You smiled, so I squint my eyes too.

lines.zh: 水面把你也照进去了
lines.en: The water surface reflects you as well.

lines.zh: 你要走的话，我不送
lines.en: If you leave, I will not see you off.

lines.zh: 谁打我，我正吃着草
lines.en: Who hit me? I was eating grass.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，可这一下也疼
lines.en: My hide is thick, but that still hurt.

lines.zh: 别砍我的毛皮，还没长好
lines.en: Do not cut my fur, it has not grown in.

lines.zh: 我往水里退，水里安全些
lines.en: I retreat toward the water, which feels safer.

lines.zh: 这一道伤，得晒几天太阳
lines.en: A wound like this needs days of sunlight.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是把牙咬紧
lines.en: I do not cry out, I just clench my teeth.

lines.zh: 你下手这么重，为什么
lines.en: Why did you strike so hard?

lines.zh: 同伴都往后退了，我也退
lines.en: My herd backed away, and so did I.

lines.zh: 血滴在泥上，颜色很暗
lines.en: Blood drips on the mud, dark in color.

lines.zh: 疼得我不想动，也不想吃
lines.en: It hurts enough that I do not want to move.

lines.zh: 是甘蔗，我闻到甜味了
lines.en: Sugarcane, I can smell the sweetness.

lines.zh: 这块瓜皮，我一口就吞
lines.en: This melon rind I will swallow in one bite.

lines.zh: 你把草放低点，我够得着
lines.en: Lower the grass a bit so I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我不争，但这份得给我
lines.en: I do not fight, but this share is mine.

lines.zh: 嫩叶比老叶好吃多了
lines.en: Tender leaves taste far better than old ones.

lines.zh: 水里的草我也吃，不挑
lines.en: I eat water weeds too, I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你晃晃那根草，我就过来了
lines.en: Wave that grass and I will come over.

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候，我最有耐心
lines.en: When eating, I am at my most patient.

lines.zh: 这味道像雨后的河滩
lines.en: This tastes like the riverbank after rain.

lines.zh: 苹果也可以，我不嫌弃
lines.en: Apples are fine too, I will not complain.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼，你慢慢等
lines.en: I chew slowly and you wait slowly.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，还想要下一口
lines.en: Mouth full, and I still want the next bite.

lines.zh: 为这根甘蔗，我肯站起来
lines.en: For this sugarcane I am willing to stand.

lines.zh: 你带的比岸边的草好多了
lines.en: What you brought beats the riverside grass.

lines.zh: 你手里那把嫩草，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the tender grass in your hand.

lines.zh: 你把草靠近，我的鼻子先动。
lines.en: You bring the grass closer, and my nose moves first.

lines.zh: 你撞我一下，我不动
lines.en: You bumped me once, and I did not move.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，绕一下更方便
lines.en: I am this big, so going around is easier.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞上我的肚子
lines.en: Your knee met my very round belly.

lines.zh: 别挤，河岸就这么宽
lines.en: Do not crowd, the bank is only so wide.

lines.zh: 我一挪身，你也得让让
lines.en: When I shift my bulk, you must shift too.

lines.zh: 踩到你脚了，我不是故意的
lines.en: I stepped on your foot, and it was not intended.

lines.zh: 水边滑，撞一下容易摔
lines.en: The bank is slippery and a bump means a fall.

lines.zh: 我这体重，撞着还是有分量的
lines.en: At my weight, a bump has some substance.

lines.zh: 干脆一起下水，就不用挤了
lines.en: Let us both get in the water and stop crowding.

lines.zh: 撞完我继续发呆，不记仇
lines.en: After the bump I go back to staring, no grudge.

lines.zh: 她坐在我旁边，尾巴挨着尾巴
lines.en: She sits beside me, tail against tail.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，很花时间
lines.en: We groom each other, and it takes a while.

lines.zh: 水里转圈的时候，她跟着我
lines.en: When I circle in the water, she follows.

lines.zh: 我这副模样，她居然喜欢
lines.en: She actually likes the way I look.

lines.zh: 以后小水豚会跟在我们后面
lines.en: Soon the little ones will trail behind us.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起睡，暖和
lines.en: We sleep pressed together, and it keeps us warm.

lines.zh: 她一叫，我就知道该走了
lines.en: When she calls, I know it is time to go.

lines.zh: 这片河湾够我们两家吃
lines.en: This bend of the river feeds both our families.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰她的耳朵
lines.en: I nudge her ear gently with my snout.

lines.zh: 一起泡在水里，谁也不说话
lines.en: Soaking in the water together, neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根草，慢慢嚼
lines.en: I pick up a blade of grass and chew.

lines.zh: 水面的叶子，我用嘴够到了
lines.en: I reached the floating leaf with my mouth.

lines.zh: 这块根茎挺沉，我拖着走
lines.en: This root is heavy, so I drag it along.

lines.zh: 掉在水里的果子，我捞起来
lines.en: A fruit fell in the water, and I fished it out.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住，免得滚走
lines.en: I hold it with my forepaws so it cannot roll.

lines.zh: 泥里的东西，我先闻再吃
lines.en: Things in the mud, I sniff before eating.

lines.zh: 嘴里叼着草，还能再叼一根
lines.en: With grass in my mouth, I can take one more.

lines.zh: 这块瓜太重，得分两次搬
lines.en: This melon is heavy, so I will move it in two trips.

lines.zh: 我捡的不多，够吃就行
lines.en: I do not gather much, just enough to eat.

lines.zh: 有东西黏在脚上，我甩一甩
lines.en: Something is stuck to my foot, so I shake it.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里动，我抬头
lines.en: Something moves in the grass, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 那家伙离我的小崽太近了
lines.en: That one is far too close to my young.

lines.zh: 谁想抢我的甘蔗
lines.en: Who wants to take my sugarcane?

lines.zh: 我看见水里的影子了
lines.en: I saw the shadow in the water.

lines.zh: 它要是不动，我也不动
lines.en: If it does not move, neither will I.

lines.zh: 我站起来，已经很说明问题
lines.en: Me standing up already says a great deal.

lines.zh: 这只鳄鱼在岸边转了很久
lines.en: That caiman has been circling the bank for a while.

lines.zh: 我护着身后那群小的
lines.en: I am shielding the little ones behind me.

lines.zh: 它退到水里去了，行吧
lines.en: It retreated into the water, fine then.

lines.zh: 我不爱打架，但会挡在前面
lines.en: I dislike fighting, but I will stand in front.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，慢慢往水边退
lines.en: I watch it and slowly back toward the water.

lines.zh: 它靠近一步，我就低一次头
lines.en: Each step it takes, I lower my head once.

lines.zh: 我用牙齿磕出声响，警告它
lines.en: I clack my teeth loudly as a warning.

lines.zh: 水里我比它快，它知道
lines.en: In the water I am faster, and it knows.

lines.zh: 它绕着走，我跟着转
lines.en: It circles around, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我咬起来也不轻
lines.en: Do not corner me; my bite is not gentle.

lines.zh: 我把小的挡在身后
lines.en: I keep the little ones behind my body.

lines.zh: 它停下，我也停下，比耐心
lines.en: It stops, so I stop, and we wait.

lines.zh: 这一片河滩，我熟得很
lines.en: I know every inch of this riverbank.

lines.zh: 它要是下水，我就跟下去
lines.en: If it enters the water, I will follow.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，就不松
lines.en: I clamp my teeth and refuse to release.

lines.zh: 这两颗大门牙，能咬断草茎
lines.en: These front teeth can snap a stem.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞过去，它退了
lines.en: I rammed it with my bulk, and it backed off.

lines.zh: 咬完我喘了半天
lines.en: After the bite I panted for a long while.

lines.zh: 我很少动手，这次是例外
lines.en: I rarely fight, and this is an exception.

lines.zh: 它被我顶进浅水，站不稳
lines.en: I shoved it into the shallows where it stumbled.

lines.zh: 牙齿磕在一起，声音很响
lines.en: My teeth clacked together with a loud sound.

lines.zh: 打完我退开，不想再追
lines.en: Afterward I withdraw, with no wish to chase.

lines.zh: 这一口只用了三分力
lines.en: That bite used only a third of my strength.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把水抖掉
lines.en: I shake my head to fling the water off.

lines.zh: 我出生在河湾的草窝里
lines.en: I was born in a grass nest by the river bend.

lines.zh: 睁眼时，身边都是同伴
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, companions were all around.

lines.zh: 我第一次下水，呛了两口
lines.en: My first swim, and I swallowed two mouthfuls.

lines.zh: 母兽用鼻子把我推向前
lines.en: My mother nudged me forward with her nose.

lines.zh: 岸上的草比我还高
lines.en: The grass on the bank was taller than me.

lines.zh: 我学着啃第一根嫩草
lines.en: I learned to nibble my first tender grass.

lines.zh: 水声一直响，我睡得很沉
lines.en: The water kept murmuring, and I slept deeply.

lines.zh: 那天阳光很好，河面发亮
lines.en: The sun was fine that day and the river shone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走到群体中间
lines.en: I slowly walked into the middle of the herd.

lines.zh: 这片河滩，从此归我们
lines.en: This riverbank belongs to us from now on.

lines.zh: 毛尖烧卷了，一股焦味
lines.en: The tips of my fur curled and smell burnt.

lines.zh: 从岸上摔下来，屁股先着地
lines.en: I fell off the bank and landed on my rear.

lines.zh: 水草缠住脚，我差点上不来
lines.en: Weeds caught my feet and I nearly did not surface.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我被掀进河里
lines.en: A blast threw me into the river.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，跑起来一晃一晃
lines.en: An arrow in my back wobbles as I run.

lines.zh: 那道光让我浑身发冷
lines.en: That light left me cold all over.

lines.zh: 岸边的草被吃光了，我饿着
lines.en: The bank's grass is gone and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷劈在河面上，我耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: Lightning struck the river and my ears rang.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界了，四肢乱蹬
lines.en: I fell out of the world, legs flailing.
